invariants.invariant: Pure core, native edge: action/key/config/tab/theme state remains Foundation-only; AppKit/PDFKit own platform effects.
invariants.implementationEvidence: PDFReaderCore contains Foundation-only action, key, config, tab, and theme state; PDFReaderApp owns AppKit/PDFKit adapters and effects.
invariants.testEvidence: AUD-CORE-01 plus Debug, Release, and warnings-as-errors builds pass.
invariants.reviewEvidence: Independent code-reviewer APPROVE and architect CLEAR; see artifacts/verification/final/review/.

invariants.invariant: One configurable command path: menu, key, prompt, and tests dispatch the same stable action IDs.
invariants.implementationEvidence: Keyboard, menus, prompts, empty-state controls, and tab controls converge on ActionDispatcher and the stable ActionID registry.
invariants.testEvidence: Dispatcher, menu, input-router, pointer-control, AUD-CMD-01/02, and AUD-MENU-01 checks pass.
invariants.reviewEvidence: Independent code-reviewer APPROVE and architect CLEAR; see artifacts/verification/final/review/.

invariants.invariant: Read-only containment: production session interfaces expose no PDF/page/annotation/form mutation or write/export capability; excluded behavior is suppressed and source hashes remain unchanged.
invariants.implementationEvidence: PDFCapabilityPolicy and ReaderPDFView suppress inherited mutation, form, annotation, print, export, and write behavior; production session interfaces expose only viewer operations.
invariants.testEvidence: Read-only source-hash, form, annotation, capability, AUD-RO-01, and AUD-INFO-01 checks pass.
invariants.reviewEvidence: Independent code-reviewer APPROVE and architect CLEAR; see artifacts/verification/final/review/.

invariants.invariant: Strict declarative configuration: bounded TOML input is recursively allowlisted, sparse input overlays typed built-ins, activation is atomic, and any error falls back to complete defaults with diagnostics.
invariants.implementationEvidence: ConfigFileSource, TOMLConfigDecoder, ConfigService, and the pure validator implement bounded allowlisting, typed overlay, atomic activation, aggregate diagnostics, and complete-default fallback without executable hooks.
invariants.testEvidence: Config loading, validation, fallback, diagnostics, AUD-CONFIG-01/02, and exact TOMLDecoder 0.4.5 dependency checks pass.
invariants.reviewEvidence: Independent code-reviewer APPROVE and architect CLEAR; see artifacts/verification/final/review/.

invariants.invariant: Deterministic input ownership: window-scoped responder routing, four contexts, prefix epochs, native prompt/IME precedence, and one shared prompt-safety predicate.
invariants.implementationEvidence: Window-scoped routing, four input contexts, trie epochs, g+digits replay, the AppKit adapter, prompt composition lifecycle, and the shared prompt-safety predicate are explicit.
invariants.testEvidence: Engine, grammar, adapter, router, prompt-composition, focus-loop, and AUD-INPUT-01/02 checks pass.
invariants.reviewEvidence: Independent code-reviewer APPROVE and architect CLEAR; see artifacts/verification/final/review/.

invariants.invariant: Session isolation: each tab owns one PDFDocument, PDFView, and serialized search coordinator; ReaderSessionStore alone owns session lifetime.
invariants.implementationEvidence: ReaderSessionStore is the sole session owner; each TabID maps to one ReaderSession with its own PDFDocument, PDFViewController/PDFView, and ReaderSearchCoordinator.
invariants.testEvidence: Session, tab, two-tab isolation, topology caching, search replacement/teardown, and AUD-SESSION-01 checks pass.
invariants.reviewEvidence: Independent code-reviewer APPROVE and architect CLEAR; see artifacts/verification/final/review/.

invariants.invariant: Scope control: no editing, annotations, bookmarks, OCR, sidebar, thumbnails, print/export, persistence, scripts, plugins, macros, or distribution work.
invariants.implementationEvidence: The compact 27-action registry, capability policy, session interfaces, and canvas-first shell omit every excluded surface, while tabs and four semantic dark themes remain within the approved viewer scope.
invariants.testEvidence: Product-scope, capability, persistence, security, ABI, source-audit, and E2E11/15 source checks pass with no prohibited production override or extension surface.
invariants.reviewEvidence: Independent code-reviewer APPROVE and architect CLEAR; see artifacts/verification/final/review/.
